sn42.9:1.1: Text is in error here, as Nāḷandā is in Magadha, not Kosala.
sn42.9:2.1: Read _duhitikā setaṭṭikā_ as proposed by von Hinüber (“The Ghost Word Dvı̄hitikā and the Description of Famines in Early Buddhist Literature”) and adopted by Bodhi (*Connected Discourses*, note 347).
sn42.9:3.6: Note the similarity to Mahakassapa’s criticism of Ananda at SN 16.11
sn42.9:4.5: This is the time of the Buddha Vipassī ([dn14:1.4.1]()).
